sm: This news roundup opened with a Delta problem in the system that calculates plane weight and balance, which caused a long ground delay in Atlanta before being resolved. Credit card debt hit a record one point three trillion dollars after growing twenty-two billion in the third quarter, even as holiday sales are forecast to top a trillion dollars. A Thanksgiving meal for ten costs about four hundred thirty dollars, up roughly six percent, while the national gas average is three sixty-four, with Nashville near three nineteen. A Takata airbag recall covers some Honda and Toyota vehicles, and several people were hurt when an Amtrak train hit a semi-truck in Louisiana. Nvidia's board reinstated CEO Jensen Huang after President Trump pushed for it, though lawmakers still want answers, and Huang is expected to testify in the Senate on December third.
